# R449 — main `generate.cpp` の機能依存と SYCL port contract

日付: 2026-10-14 (Asia/Tokyo)

## 対象と制約

読み取り専用のソース調査。対象 feature/sycl `/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl`, HEAD `36cc848a0eb68b96a1ed2ec007c5d86cfb3b13a7`; main `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata`, HEAD `beddab2fd6b61631d73b39b7484bc9a585ebe1de`; 共通祖先 `d988955e141190bc079b58ab3d3038da637ad070`。Niko1221/Strata が唯一の upstream とするプロジェクト指示に従い、XeStrata は採用根拠にしていない（この限定範囲では参照不要）。機材前提は Arc B570 / Ryzen 5600X / 128 GB RAM。source/Git/build/test/GPU/env/fetch は変更・実行していない。raw/private JSON と環境ログは読まず、指定済み compact R447/R448 audit report のみ参照した。成果物は本レポートだけ。

R447は機能名の棚卸しが主で、ここでは main generator のコマンド契約を primary の実際の session/prefill/cache API へ落とした。main `generate.cpp` はCUDA実装とCLI/protocolを一つの大きな関数に同居させる。機能行を選んで移植し、CUDA計算部をコピーしない。

## compile contract: mainを無変更でコピーできない理由

mainの新機能は `generate.cpp` parser/options と serve loop の局所 struct/lambda 群を直接参照する。BGEN対応箇所だけでも既存 session と prefill に加え、BSlotごとの `SessionState`, CUDA stream, prefill/cache state, checkpoint vectors、worker input queue/mutex、batch window dispatcher が必要になる。VRAMコマンドは `cudaMemGetInfo`, `cudaFree`, segment-backed expert cacheのresize/refill、between-request invariantを直接呼ぶ。`--remote-expert-opt` は `RemoteExpertOpt` と `RemoteExperts` attachを要求する。mainの header/API群を featureへコピーしても同名型の同等性はない。

Primaryには CUDA spelling の source compatibility shim があるが、限定した backend contract である。`src/sycl/compat.cpp:163-179` はdevice ordinal 0以外とpeer GPU copyを `cudaErrorNotSupported` にする。`:236-242` arbitrary host mapping registration不可、`:540-544` native SYCL recordingのgraph node introspection不可、`:576-580` kernel params introspection不可。SYCL runtimeはdevice/host USMを要求する (`src/sycl/runtime.cpp:20`)、queueは `Runtime::make_queue` 経由 (`:77-84`)。したがって HIP/CUDAのdevice affinity / peer placement / managed mapping / VMM / event timingの前提は型名一致でも満たされない。`cudaMemGetInfo` も free-memory aspect依存 (`compat.cpp:213-221`)。

Primary `SessionState` は device buffersとper-layer recurrence/KV plus `ple_prev`, `ple_token`, `ple_hist`, `PleRun` を保持し (`include/strata/core/session.hpp:30-88`)、`session_init/zero/token` を公開する (`:97-122`)。Captured routeには `SessionGraphs` / `SessionLoopScratch` と callbacksを持つ `session_loop` があり (`:390-410`)、token graph APIは別 (`:412+`). Per-request BSlotがmainの `SessionState` を持つだけではなく独立 state allocationとreset/restoreが必要。Featureには `Prefill` abstractionがあり (`include/strata/prefill/prefill.hpp:43+`)、`init/run/reset`, chunk sizing/borrowing/refillのライフタイムとCPU expert answersが結び付く。main `Prefill`の `bytes_needed`, `relayout`, CUDA copy/refillはそのままは合わない。

## 機能別 port plan /依存関係

| main 機能 (main source locations) | 本当に必要な依存・意味 | primaryへの具体的適合先 /制約 |
|---|---|---|
| `BGEN`, `BGENI` admission (`src/program/generate.cpp` main lines 6212-6225; options/help 624-629)、batch/slots/groups | `--batch` slot count、`--batch-groups` window scheduling、各slotのSessionState/context + generated IDs / max_new / stop/cancel state、prompt cache reuse、image payload (BGENI)。BGEN/BGENIは通常GEN/GENIへ変換されるだけでなく admit_slot/max_newを設定する。 | まず single-session chunked `Prefill::run`/`session_token`/`session_loop` と server single-request contract上で slot state isolationを定義。並列 decodeなら複数独立 device session buffersとworker/job queue及びGPU schedulingが先。Arc B570一基なので multi-GPU split/group pipeline/peer cacheは対象外。ただし同一GPUで複数sessionを安全に多重化できるかはcapacity/queue lifetime評価が要る。`SessionState::session_zero` をslotごと呼ぶだけでは slotごとのメモリがない。|
| `BSTOP`, `BYIELD` cooperative yield (main lines 6195-6202, 6857-6929) | BSTOPはslotの次のbatch windowで止める。BYIELDはprompt chunk境界で既読prefixをtarget slotへ移し、`YIELDED <slot> <tokens>` + cancel DONEを返し、再admit時に同じchunk読込を継続。条件に `prompt_cache>0`, text-only, slot free, remaining > max(chunk,short_read) がある。 | Primaryのper-request prefill chunk boundaryをyield pointにできるが、保存対象をprompt token IDsだけにしない。session recurrence/KV/indexer/Ple/checkpointsまでcopy/restore可能性が必要。Primary conversation checkpoint API `include/strata/core/conversation_snapshot.hpp` and `src/core/conversation_state.cpp` own checkpoint/snapshot validation/save/restore. Reuse exact compatible API; never byte-copy CUDA slot buffers. Existing tests listed below do not cover BGEN protocol in feature tree. |
| `--tail-role-token` checkpoint placement (main option 517-ish; behavior lines 6972-6979) | Turn boundary scan: previous role turn immediately before current turn is excluded from reusable checkpoint if first token after prior turn marker is configured role token; reasoning-effort suffix is reread. It only changes checkpoint prefix, not emitted prompt. | Implement in checkpoint boundary calculation over the exact token vector used by primary prompt cache. Keep all tokens in current request execution; checkpoint must save state at boundary and cached IDs must match that boundary. Tests should cover with/without prior role token, token position at resume boundary, cache hit and next request output. Existing tests: `tools/test_conversation_cache_*`, `serve/test_server.py`; no exact tail-role fixture identified. |
| `VRAM [reserve_mib]` runtime control, `--vram-elastic`, `--vram-segment-mib` (main lines 3315+, 5760-5872, parser/help 621-624) | Between-request operation only, one CUDA GPU, `--serve`, not low-RAM mode, no peer GPU, no outstanding prompt loan, no active batch. Shrinks/grows segmented expert cache and refills displaced blobs while honoring startup reserve. | API concept is reserve/release capacity only if SYCL allocator/cache owns releasable segments and can synchronously refill before next request. Primary expert cache/session/prefill borrowing must report live allocation and in-flight event ownership. Current `cudaFree` facade does not imply CUDA VMM semantics; no evidence primary cache exposes segment resize. For now expose capability/error response rather than pretending resize works; keep generic free-memory reporting if aspect is available. Existing feature tests: `tests/sycl/*` cover kernels and prefill state/storage, not runtime VRAM route. Main source tests named in R447: `serve/test_vram.py`; test idle/busy, incompatible config, OOM/refill failure. |
| `--expert-cache-deviceN N|auto`, `--remote-expert-opt` (main options around lines 3554-3664 and parser 1375) | Per-device expert capacity selection after weights loaded; remote `RemoteExperts` caches, placement/profile, attach `RemoteExpertOpt`, peer copies, decode callback pointers. | One-device adapter enforces ordinal 0 and rejects peer copy. Preserve CLI parser only if it gives explicit capability error or maps auto to local cache. Do not include `.cu`/remote peer algorithm. General `auto` local capacity can reuse primary free-memory query and existing `ExpertCache` sizing only after its reserved buffers/workspaces are accounted. Test unsupported explicit secondary device and auto single-device behavior. Main tests: `tests/core/expert_cache_segmented_test.cpp`, remote setup tests; feature has `tests/sycl` for prefill but no batch remote equivalence. |
| `--trim-stage-weights` | Only has effect with explicit layer split; frees non-stage weights on split GPU after staged load. | Not needed on single B570. Reject/diagnose split-only option as unsupported instead of silent no-op. Primary adapter ordinal constraint already rejects device >0. |
| `--batch-groups` | Only meaningful for batch and explicit group divisibility; otherwise main warns/falls back to one. Allows pipelined groups/stages. | No multi-stage group scheduler for one GPU. Preserve validation/help semantics only if batching port exists; don't import stage queueing. |

### Session and prefill member/method map to make a real batch port reviewable

Main's code uses a `BSlot` local state object and `PfPart` per device/stage, but feature must represent equivalent ownership using primary objects:

- For every live slot: its own `SessionState` memory carve (`session_bytes/session_init`), `session_zero` on reset, sampler/generated sequence and checkpoint set. `SessionState` includes GDN state, QSA state arena, MoE/block scratch, residual, layer range, and PLE sequence state (`session.hpp:30-88`). KV positional buffers and cache validity must be initialized consistently; do not alias mutable state across slots.
- Decoding path uses either direct `session_token` or captured `session_loop` / token graph with its required graph inputs, expert-parts answer buffer, event/doorbell and `SessionLoopScratch`; `session_loop` callback order (`session.hpp:390-410`) must remain per slot and callbacks cannot write another slot's `parts` or ring.
- Prompt path uses `Prefill::init/run/reset`, per-request token position, chunk size, and storage/cache-lending contract. On cached resume, restore a validated checkpoint before processing suffix; on yield copy/restore only through supported conversation snapshot APIs. Per-slot chunk input, output logits/selected token and queue completion need owning lifetime until SYCL events complete.
- `BGENI` additionally relies on image tokenization/vision context. It is not just another prefix. Feature API coverage for it must be separately proven.

These are necessary dependency slots, not assertions that each primary API currently supports multiple concurrent sequences. R447 already noted feature/main server service protocol and focused test gaps.

## Existing tests and required validation mapping (not executed)

Main's specific candidate tests from R447: `serve/test_parallel.py`, `tools/batch_test.py`, `tools/batch_interleave_test.py`, `tools/early_close_test.py`, `serve/test_vram.py`, `tests/core/expert_cache_segmented_test.cpp`, `serve/test_server.py`. These can specify protocol expectations but are not tests for SYCL adaptation. Primary's existing tests found: `tests/sycl/prefill_fused.cpp`, `prefill_mmq.cpp`, `prefill_postops.cpp`, `prefill_state.cpp`, `prefill_storage.cpp`; `src/core/conversation_snapshot_test.cpp`, `src/core/conversation_validation_test.cpp`, `src/core/conversation_cache_test.cpp`, `src/core/conversation_memory_test.cpp`; `tools/test_conversation_cache_disabled.py`, `growth.py`, `http_smoke.py`, `isolation.py`, `parity.py`, `soak.py`; `serve/test_server.py`. They exercise components but no identified BGEN/BSTOP/BYIELD parser/protocol regression test. Do not claim feature parity from kernel or ordinary server tests. If implemented, protocol tests need fake/mock engine transcripts for slot isolation, STOP boundary, BYIELD save/resume of partial prompt, disconnect/cancel, BGENI, and no interleaving of runtime VRAM command with active requests; then separate correctness tests for state restore and full model output.

## Safe fixes to carry independently

- Keep stop/cancel checks at safe chunk/window boundaries; don't poll/interrupt inside a SYCL submission whose buffers or captured state can be reused before event completion.
- Validate BGEN slot index, free/active state, max_new positive, and protocol parse before touching session state (main lines 6212-6225).
- BYIELD must be all-or-nothing: failed slot copy clears partial validity; resume token count must match restored state; existing main path explicitly invalidates a half-written target slot (6918-6920). Preserve this behavior via validated snapshot API.
- For `--tail-role-token`, only adjust cache checkpoint boundary; do not truncate the request's actual prompt or mutate token IDs.
- VRAM resize must be rejected while any request, prompt-buffer loan, SYCL event/queue use, or batch window owns its backing storage. Check capability before mutating cache, and leave current capacity unchanged if refill fails.
- `auto` cache sizing must distinguish device-reported free memory from allocator-owned and prompt/session scratch; don't blindly use whole device free bytes.
- Keep failures explicit: unsupported layer split/remote placement/runtime elastic capacity should report capability error, not silently claim success.

## Evidence/source locations

- main `generate.cpp`: option state and help around 300-530; parser around 1375-1434; BGEN admission 6212-6225; BSTOP/BYIELD parsing 6195-6203 and yield boundaries 6857-6929; tail role 6972-6979; VRAM runtime command 5760-5872; remote opt construction 3554-3664.
- primary API: `include/strata/core/session.hpp:30-122,390-410`; `include/strata/prefill/prefill.hpp:28-100`; `src/core/session.cpp`; `src/core/conversation_state.cpp`; `src/sycl/compat.cpp:151-179,213-242,302-424,540-580`; `src/sycl/runtime.cpp:20,77-84`.
- R447 compact audit: `bench/results/2026-10-14-primary-strata-source-audit/research/research-primary-main-functional-reconciliation-round447-v1.txt.json`; R448 compact inference source audit: sibling `research-primary-inference-adoption-audit-round448-v1.txt.json`.

## Limits

No compile/test/GPU run, no API behavior test, no remote/upstream provenance verification in this pass. Several exact class/header names for main-local BSlot and batch helpers are local to `generate.cpp` and need line-level review during implementation. Recommendation is a scoped port plan, not a finding that batch/elastic/remote features already work on SYCL. Primary current tree is not Niko upstream state; code-origin classification is outside this task.
